shop/ends

What it is
  What is done as it stops, fails, or takes a new text.
  It keeps, from one run to the next: `open`.
  It writes nothing down as it goes: stopped in the middle, it is begun again from its start by whatever asked for it.
  It goes on running once its steps are done, for what it hears.
  It gives out: `thing`.

What it makes
  A thing called `shelf`. [made]

What it does when it is applied
  1. Make sure a thing is there. [made]

What it hears, and what it then does
  When this happens: a thing was changed (`thing.changed`). Heard from its own project, and from the factory itself. [changed]
    1. Do nothing. [run]

What it may do
  It runs as whoever applies it, and can do no more than they can.
  Of what they can do, it uses only what it lists: `things` and `post`.
  Read things. [things:read]
  Make and change things. [things:write]
  Send letters. [post:send]

What it does as it ends or is changed
  When its steps went well:
    - Write a line in the run's log.
  When its steps fail:
    - Send a letter.
  When its steps have ended, however they went:
    - Write a line in the run's log.
  When it takes a new text while it is running, in place of running its steps again:
    - Keep `open`.
    - Send a letter. Only when `version` of the instance as it was before this text is not `2`.
  When it is stopped:
    - Read a thing.
